sources.summary: Agentic RL research is constant algorithm modification, and in mainstream frameworks every change threads through trainer, distributed backend, and rollout glue. NVIDIA's Molt targets that cost with about 8.6K lines of RL code, composing Ray, vLLM, and NeMo AutoModel around one asynchronous loop. The agent stays ordinary Python, trajectories stay token-exact, and throughput comes out statistically comparable to a Megatron-based stack. The post NVIDIA AI Releases Molt: A PyTorch-Native Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost .
